title: The trace of a constructible set on a constructible set is constructible there
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space which has a basis of the topology consisting of quasi-compact open subsets. Let $E,E'\subseteq X$ be constructible subsets of $X$ [def-weil-constructible-subset]. Then $E\cap E'$ is a constructible subset of the topological space $E$ (with the subspace topology) [def-weil-constructible-subset] (Stacks Topology, Lemma 09YI).

source.place: Topology, Lemma Tag 09YI (Lemma 5.15.11, lemma-intersect-constructible-with-constructible, line 2750; its proof combines Lemmas 09YF and 09YH)

proof.text: *$E$ is retrocompact in $X$.* By [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-is-retrocompact] (Stacks 09YH) the constructible subset $E$ of $X$ is retrocompact in $X$ [def-weil-constructible-subset]: $E\cap W$ is quasi-compact for every quasi-compact open $W\subseteq X$. This is hypothesis (1) of Stacks 09YF for $T=E$; hypothesis (2) is the assumption on $X$. (Throughout, a subset of $E$ is quasi-compact in the subspace $E$ if and only if it is quasi-compact in $X$, since the topology of $E$ is induced from $X$.)

source.place: Topology, Lemma Tag 09YI (lemma-intersect-constructible-with-constructible, line 2750), proof ('Combine Lemmas 09YF and 09YH'); Lemma Tag 09YH (lemma-constructible-is-retrocompact)

proof.text: *Quasi-compact opens of $E$ come from quasi-compact opens of $X$ (the 'details omitted' of 09YF).* Let $W\subseteq E$ be open in $E$ and quasi-compact. Then $W=E\cap O$ for an open $O\subseteq X$, and $O=\bigcup_j B_j$ with $B_j\subseteq X$ quasi-compact open, since these form a basis of $X$. The sets $E\cap B_j$ are open in $E$ and cover $W$, so finitely many of them, $E\cap B_1,\dots,E\cap B_m$, cover $W$; as each is contained in $W$, $W=E\cap W'$ with $W'=B_1\cup\dots\cup B_m$, which is open and quasi-compact in $X$ (a finite union of quasi-compact subsets is quasi-compact).

source.place: Topology, Lemma Tag 09YF (lemma-intersect-constructible-with-retrocompact, line 2676), proof, applied with T = E ('we can find a quasi-compact open $W'\subset X$ such that $W=T\cap W'$ (details omitted)'); the details are written out here by the agent

proof.text: *Retrocompact opens of $X$ restrict to retrocompact opens of $E$.* Let $V\subseteq X$ be open and retrocompact in $X$ [def-weil-constructible-subset]. Then $V\cap E$ is open in $E$. Let $W\subseteq E$ be a quasi-compact open of $E$ and write $W=E\cap W'$ with $W'\subseteq X$ quasi-compact open (step 2). Then $(V\cap E)\cap W=E\cap(V\cap W')$. Here $V\cap W'$ is open, and quasi-compact because $V$ is retrocompact in $X$; hence $E\cap(V\cap W')$ is quasi-compact because $E$ is retrocompact in $X$ (step 1). So $V\cap E$ is retrocompact in $E$.

source.place: Topology, Lemma Tag 09YF (lemma-intersect-constructible-with-retrocompact, line 2676), proof, applied with T = E ('Hence $V\cap T\cap W=V\cap T\cap W'$ is the intersection of $T$ with the quasi-compact open $V\cap W'$ ... Thus $V\cap T\cap W$ is quasi-compact')

proof.text: *Conclusion.* Let $\iota:E\to X$ be the inclusion of the subspace $E$; it is continuous, and by step 3 the inverse image $\iota^{-1}(V)=V\cap E$ of every retrocompact open $V\subseteq X$ is retrocompact in $E$. By [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-preimage] (Stacks 005I) the inverse image $\iota^{-1}(E')=E\cap E'$ of the constructible subset $E'$ of $X$ is constructible in $E$ [def-weil-constructible-subset]. (Explicitly: if $E'=\bigcup_{i=1}^n U_i\cap(X\setminus V_i)$ with $U_i,V_i$ retrocompact open in $X$, then $E\cap E'=\bigcup_{i=1}^n(U_i\cap E)\cap(E\setminus(V_i\cap E))$ with $U_i\cap E$, $V_i\cap E$ retrocompact open in $E$ by step 3.)
